name: Prowlarr
description: Keeps one list of torrent and Usenet indexers for Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr.
notes: The first visit asks you to choose how to sign in. Add your indexers, then Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr under Settings → Apps, by the server's LAN address and each one's API key (in its Settings → General); Prowlarr then keeps their indexer lists up to date.
